verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no documented export or API for pushing Aleph's model outputs (forecasts, scenarios, metrics) into a warehouse or internal tool. The '150+ connectors, plus anything with an API' claim describes inbound data consolidation. Bi-directional Excel/Google Sheets sync is a spreadsheet workflow, an adjacent feature rather than a developer-facing warehouse or API export. Probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec at any candidate path.
